title: logstable boolean option defaults must be set in 3 places
answers: Why does my logstable panel option change in the UI not match its documented default?
How do I change the default value of a logstable panel boolean switch option?
hoverOverflow / wrapText option default is inconsistent between editor and rendered table
Changing a panel option's default value in logstable
body:
Symptom: a logstable boolean panel option (e.g. hoverOverflow) shows the wrong default state in the options editor, or the table renders with the old default even though the editor says otherwise.
Root cause: the effective default for a logstable boolean option is independently defined in three places that can drift: the standalone editor's `value ?? <default>` fallback (public/app/plugins/panel/logstable/HoverOverflowEditor.tsx), the panel plugin's builder `.addBooleanSwitch({ defaultValue })` (public/app/plugins/panel/logstable/module.tsx), and the runtime options merge `options.<field> ?? <default>` used to build final table options (public/app/plugins/panel/logstable/LogsTable.tsx).
Fix pattern: when changing a boolean option's default, update all three fallbacks together so the editor's unset-switch state, the plugin schema's declared default, and the actual rendered behavior agree.
Constraints: applies to any boolean/string panel option in this plugin builder pattern that has both a custom editor with its own fallback and a separate consumer-side merge fallback; does not apply to options with a single source of truth (no custom editor, or no separate runtime merge).
applies: Grafana logstable panel plugin options with custom StandardEditorProps editors

search: logstable boolean panel option defaults must be synchronized in three places to prevent display and rendering mismatches: the editor's fallback (HoverOverflowEditor.tsx, `value ?? <default>`), the plugin builder's declaration (module.tsx, `.addBooleanSwitch({ defaultValue })`), and the runtime merge (LogsTable.tsx, `options.<field> ?? <default>`). When changing a boolean option default, update all three locations together so the unset-switch state, schema default, and rendered behavior agree. This rule only applies to boolean/string options that have both a custom StandardEditorProps editor and a separate consumer-side merge fallback; does not apply to options with a single source of truth. Misalignment causes the editor UI to display one default while the table renders with another.
